messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — I'm coordinating a cross-repo version bump for tomorrow's cutoff. Proposal: API -> v0.14.1, runtime -> v0.15.0, console -> v0.10.0, js-sdk -> v1.4.0, py-sdk -> v0.9.0. Flag blockers now.

Maria Gonzales: What cutoff/time window are we targeting? Any schema/migration notes for runtime KV cache?

Samir Patel: I can own runtime PRs. Prefer we stagger canaries: runtime first, then API, then console/SDKs. 30m gap between major steps.

Kevin Wu: Console team ok with bump but need a short changelog blurb from API owners (breaking? minor?). Also confirm if client typed surface changes in js-sdk will require console tweaks.

Lina (oncall): Oncall note: I'll schedule smoke + acceptance runs. Please ensure rollback tags are ready. Canaries at 18:00 UTC look good for me.

release-bot: release-bot: Rollout window pre-seeded: 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z -> 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z. Tracking issue: https://redwood/rel/1234

Alex Chen: Thanks. Quick operational checklist I'm asking teams to follow before merging: update CHANGELOG, bump version in package metadata, run unit + integration tests, and add the cut branch label. If you need commands:
```bash
# runtime example
./scripts/bump-version.sh runtime 0.15.0
git checkout -b release/v0.15 && git push origin release/v0.15
make release && ./ci/run-smoke.sh runtime
```

Samir Patel: runtime tagging started, PRs: #789 (bump + changelog), #790 (kv-layout compatibility). Canary plan: 10% for 30m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/canary-runtime

Maria Gonzales: API team — I'll add the swagger diff and migration notes to PR #234. There is a tiny response-field rename (internal) — not breaking for clients but will mention it in changelog.

Kevin Wu: Console PR opened #456 with the changelog note. JS SDK: minor surface change, no breaking API. Will coordinate with js-sdk owners to publish v1.4.0 after API canary passes.

Alex Chen: Branch rules: please cut release branches only from main (no feature merges). Runtime -> release/v0.15, API -> release/v0.14.1, console -> release/v0.10.0. No other merges until post-cut.

Lina (oncall): Post-deploy checks I'll run: basic health endpoints, sampling traces for 5 requests, and end-to-end prompt test. If failure -> rollback to image tag annotated in PR. Ping here if rollback occurs :boom:

Samir Patel: quick note — runtime kv-cache layout is backward compatible for reads but write TTL semantics changed; added compatibility test in #790. If we see errors revert to runtime@sha:abc123.

release-bot: release-bot: Created umbrella tracking PR: https://redwood/pull/9001 (links runtime#789, api#234, console#456, js-sdk#321, py-sdk#654)

Alex Chen: Final ask: after cutover drop a single-line summary in this thread with deployed SHAs, official release tags, and any anomalies. I'll compile into release notes.

Kevin Wu: Will do.

Maria Gonzales: Done on my side — migration note added to API PR #234.

Samir Patel: Runtime PRs merged to release/v0.15, tagged runtime@v0.15.0 (sha: def456).

Lina (oncall): Canary started at 18:00 UTC. First 30m looks green. Will update at ramp.

Alex Chen: Great work team — I'll post the consolidated changelog after Lina confirms final ramp. :tada:
